description: Headless GIMP: make a selection, saved as a NAMED channel (no live selection persists between calls): rectangle/ellipse/polygon/colour range/magic wand/layer alpha/gradient/another channel. Combine add/subtract/intersect by reusing a name. Use the channel as gimp_add_adjustment's `mask` when creating a filter, or gimp_layer_mask for a real layer mask. Make selections after straighten/resize/crop.

combine.description: Combine with the existing saved selection of the same `name` (like shift/alt in a GUI). `invert`/`feather_px` apply to the NEW shape alone, before it is combined.

cx.description: gradient_radial: center x, document pixels. Default the image's own center.

cy.description: gradient_radial: center y, document pixels. Default the image's own center.

feather_px.description: Feather radius in document pixels, applied to the NEW shape alone before any `combine`. Refused (nonzero) on gradient_linear/gradient_radial -- already a continuous ramp, nothing to feather.

image.description: Image id, as returned by gimp_open_document.

invert.description: Applied to the NEW shape alone, before any `combine`. rectangle/ellipse/polygon/color_range/magic_wand/alpha/channel: invert the selection. gradient_linear/gradient_radial: swap which end is black vs white.

layer.description: Layer name. Defaults to the selected layer, or the topmost layer if none is selected. alpha: which layer. color_range/magic_wand: only matters when sample_merged:false (otherwise the visible composite is sampled, and which layer this names makes no difference to the result).

layer_id.description: Layer id, as gimp_inspect (and any tool that creates a layer) reports it. Takes priority over `layer`, and is the only way to address one of two layers that share a name. alpha: which layer. color_range/magic_wand: only matters when sample_merged:false.

mode.description: rectangle/ellipse: x, y, width, height. polygon: points (>=3 [x,y] pairs). color_range: every pixel near `color` (hex) or the colour at a sample point x,y, anywhere in the image. magic_wand: the contiguous region around x,y. alpha: a layer's opaque pixels. channel: copy another saved selection (`source`). gradient_linear: a ramp from (x1,y1) to (x2,y2), default the full image width. gradient_radial: a ramp from full effect at the center (cx,cy) fading to none at radius, default centered at the image's own center with radius = half the shorter side.

name.description: Channel to save the selection in (replaced).

radius.description: gradient_radial: radius, document pixels. Default half the shorter image side.

sample_merged.description: color_range/magic_wand: sample the visible composite. false samples the one named/selected layer's own raw pixels instead.

source.description: mode=channel: the saved selection to copy.

x.description: rectangle/ellipse/magic_wand, or color_range's sample point: left edge or point x, in image pixels from the canvas origin, also when `layer` names a layer that sits at an offset (never counted from that layer's own corner).

x1.description: gradient_linear: start point x, document pixels. Default 0.

x2.description: gradient_linear: end point x, document pixels. Default the image's width.

y.description: rectangle/ellipse/magic_wand, or color_range's sample point: top edge or point y, in image pixels from the canvas origin, also when `layer` names a layer that sits at an offset (never counted from that layer's own corner).

y1.description: gradient_linear: start point y, document pixels. Default 0.

y2.description: gradient_linear: end point y, document pixels. Default 0.

name: gimp_select
